phrases.text: Oh my! I love to read and enjoy my day off,
Especially since the weather isn't cold today.
You're right, Jaljal. Look how lovely the weather is
I'm not sure about sitting here, can we switch spots?
Why does this bird have to poop on my book?
On the contrary, Jaljal, you're lucky,
Because I heard when it falls on someone's head
The important thing is to be positive and optimistic.
Right, I need to be positive and optimistic.
If you want, we can switch spots back.
Maybe this will improve my day.
This is the sound of a bee.
It's okay, it's okay, Jaljal, enough, stay optimistic,
Things will surely get better now.
One must be positive and optimistic
Even if things don't go right.
Jaljal, what do you say we switch spots
This is what I didn't expect! A storm?
This is just what was missing!
I will be positive, I am positive.
That will fix your mood and save your day.
Here, I brought you an umbrella, Jaljal,
I'm lucky, do you know why?
Because you're my friend, and not just that,
Do you know something else, Tantoon?
That I saw how much you care to help me
Of course I love to help you, Jaljal
